name: credit-card-fraud-detection
description: Local npm orchestration for frontend, backend, and database containers

scripts.startAll: docker compose -f docker-compose.database.yml -f docker-compose.backend.yml -f docker-compose.frontend.yml up --build
scripts.startAll:detached: docker compose -f docker-compose.database.yml -f docker-compose.backend.yml -f docker-compose.frontend.yml up --build -d
scripts.startFront: docker compose -f docker-compose.frontend.yml down && docker compose -f docker-compose.frontend.yml up --build
scripts.stop: docker compose -f docker-compose.database.yml -f docker-compose.backend.yml -f docker-compose.frontend.yml down
scripts.restartAll: docker compose -f docker-compose.database.yml -f docker-compose.backend.yml -f docker-compose.frontend.yml down && docker compose -f docker-compose.database.yml -f docker-compose.backend.yml -f docker-compose.frontend.yml up --build
scripts.logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.database.yml -f docker-compose.backend.yml -f docker-compose.frontend.yml logs -f
scripts.ps: docker compose -f docker-compose.database.yml -f docker-compose.backend.yml -f docker-compose.frontend.yml ps
